notes.title: Hydrangea - Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hydrangea is available to play for FREE on Steam!

A romance/psychological horror visual novel inspired by the Hanahaki disease trope. Immerse yourself in a romance with a sweetheart you can customize. But beware, as affection turns to obsession, the petals of love may suffocate.

[h2]Features:[/h2]

  -  Choose your name, as well as your sweetheart's name, pronouns, and appearence.

  -  Contains [b]four endings.[/b] Aim to see the first three to unlock the true end.

  -  Original soundtrack, backgrounds, portraits, and CGs!

  - Story length: 20k words.

-----------
[h2]ABOUT:
[/h2]

My name is Meiri, I'm a [b]Brazilian[/b] indie dev making free horror visual novels. I led a team of volunteers to create Hydrangea for the 2024 Yandere Game Jam.

If you find typos, bugs, and other errors, please report them via e-mail. It might take me a little while to release an update, as unfortunately, I'm going through burnout regarding this project. Releasing Hydrangea was a challenge and I'm just now finally getting to wind down.

*THE TWIN CHARACTER USING THEY/THEM PRONOUNS IS NOT A BUG.

[u][b]*O PERSONAGEM DO GÊMEO USANDO PRONOMES FEMININOS E MASCULINOS NÃO É UM BUG.[/b][/u]
